slides.title: Two Weeks Then, Hours Now
headings: Before: by hand, one to two weeks per client

rows.before: Snapshot deployment: 19 scripts run one by one in SQL Developer, baselines watched by hand, validation in spreadsheets
rows.after: One command per step; baselines submitted as parallel jobs and gated; the runner logs every step
rows.proof: baseline ready gate, install gates, 12-month parity, duplicate-key safety

rows.before: Standard Offering to a client: export, edit the package, fix the datasource, import, open reports one by one
rows.after: One promotion command; the datasource is the target's own export; every resource re-exported and executed
rows.proof: Ellensburg prod in 11 minutes, Newark in 21, 0 errors

rows.before: Moving a client's reports between environments: a day per batch, breakage found later by users
rows.after: 21 College Station reports and their 13 domains, prod to test, in one morning, byte-equal
rows.proof: 22 executions on test, prod never written

rows.before: A domain change on every client: Domain Designer per org, days, no record
rows.after: One patch module, additive-only guard, applied to six orgs with seven proofs each
rows.proof: read-back byte-equal, bound views run, rows tie to Oracle

rows.before: Validation sign-off: assembled from screenshots over days
rows.after: Generated from the sweep in minutes: PASS, EMPTY, FAIL per row with timings

rows.before: Opening each Ad Hoc view in the designer by hand: the API says 'ok' but only the editor shows a broken topic

rows.before: Dashboards and themes checked by eye after formatting changes
rows.after: Playwright reads computed styles and element positions; a diff against the last good render

rows.before: Nightly builds and sweeps skip when the laptop is off the VPN: 93% of runs in the last 30 days
rows.after: AI agents hosted in the cloud on the VPN network run the nightlies, the sweeps and the parity checks continuously
rows.proof: no run depends on a person being connected

rows.before: Sign-off documents assembled when someone asks
rows.after: Continual monitoring: every change swept, every org validated, alerts on the first red row
